labels.text: Start the chat in this project

S110.24.needs: a signed-in account with at least one project
S110.24.note: The cited side_panel.ts lines have moved; the @ project menu is now at side_panel.ts around lines 14357-14511 and chooseChatProject at 13673. Whether project instructions and sources ground the answer is decided server-side and is not visible in extension code.
steps: Sign in and make sure the account has at least one project.
Click the chat box at the bottom of the side panel and type @.
Look for the menu labelled 'Tabs and projects' with a 'Projects' heading.
Click your project name (second line 'Start the chat in this project').
Look for the header chip 'Project · <name>' above the chat.
Ask a question that depends on the project's instructions or sources and compare the answer with Expected.
S110.24.where: Chat composer > type @ > Projects heading > click the project row (the row says 'Start the chat in this project'); then check the header chip 'Project · <name>'

labels.text: Your Managed Cloud usage limit has been reached.

S110.26.needs: an account whose usage is used up
S110.26.note: The gate text comes from the server when it is available and falls back to the default message; the button label depends on the recovery action returned (Add credits, Manage usage, Contact support or an upgrade label). The 'Switch model' button only opens the model picker, so a named eligible model is not offered in one step. Checked side_panel.ts:9751 and bubbles.ts:319.
steps: Use an account whose usage is used up, then send a message in the side panel chat.
Read the message that says 'Your Managed Cloud usage limit has been reached.' and the button beside it.
Click the button, for example 'Add credits', and note that a new tab opens to the AGI web page.
If a reply shows the 'Switch model' button, click it and check whether the model picker opens with a model you can pick.
Compare with Expected: one step to an eligible alternative, reset wait or purchase.
S110.26.where: Chat, under the message 'Your Managed Cloud usage limit has been reached.' > click 'Add credits' (or the other recovery label shown), which opens the AGI web app in a new tab. A failed reply can also show 'Switch model', which opens the model picker.
